# Gitea

Community managed lightweight code hosting solution written in Go

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gitea/.

## Actions

- **Get ActivityPub Person Actor** (read-only): Retrieve the ActivityPub Person actor for a Gitea user.
- **Get All Organizations** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of all organizations in the Gitea instance.
- **Get General API Settings** (read-only): Retrieve the Gitea instance's global API settings including pagination limits and response size constraints.
- **Get General Attachment Settings** (read-only): Retrieve the Gitea instance's global settings for file attachments including enabled status, allowed file types, size limits, and file…
- **Get General Repository Settings** (read-only): Retrieve the Gitea instance's global settings for repositories including feature flags for mirroring, HTTP Git, migrations, stars, time…
- **Get General UI Settings** (read-only): Retrieve the Gitea instance's global settings for UI including default theme, allowed reactions, and custom emojis.
- **Get Gitignore Template Info** (read-only): Retrieve information about a specific gitignore template.
- **Get Label Template Info** (read-only): Retrieve all labels from a specific label template.
- **Get License Template Info** (read-only): Retrieve information about a specific license template.
- **Get Node Info** (read-only): Retrieve the nodeinfo of the Gitea application.
- **Get Signing Key** (read-only): Retrieve the default GPG signing key used by Gitea to sign commits.
- **Get Version** (read-only): Retrieve the version of the Gitea application.
- **List Gitignore Templates** (read-only): Retrieve all available gitignore templates.
- **List Label Templates** (read-only): Retrieve all available label templates.
- **List License Templates** (read-only): Retrieve all available license templates.
- **List Organization Actions Secrets** (read-only): List all action secrets for an organization.
- **Render Markdown** (read-only): Render a markdown document as HTML with configurable rendering modes and context.
- **Render Markdown Raw** (read-only): Render raw markdown text as HTML.
- **Render Markup** (read-only): Render a markup document as HTML with support for multiple markup formats.
